column7: Verilog and SystemVerilog decisions decompose into stable independently addressable atomic conditions without changing expression structure
VHDL Boolean decisions use the same stable atomic-condition model while retaining language-specific operators and source identity
Condition outcome recording preserves every governed short-circuit rule and never evaluates an operand the source execution would skip
Atomic conditions record true and false outcomes plus distinct auxiliary unknown outcomes without scoring unknown as either binary result
Expression coverage expands only within a deterministic configured bound and reports every omitted combination without a synthetic completion claim
Each selected binary bit owns separate zero-to-one and one-to-zero bins with stable identity and no transition-direction aliasing
Verilog and SystemVerilog ports nets signals and retained variables receive bounded toggle inventories with exact hierarchical ownership
VHDL ports signals and retained variables receive equivalent bounded toggle inventories under every retained VHDL profile
Automatic locals memories and arrays are excluded from toggle scoring by default while every exclusion remains explicit and inspectable
Explicit bounded selection rules identify scored memory and array elements bits and ranges without silently enabling whole-container tracking
Transitions involving unknown or high-impedance values remain diagnostic observations and never satisfy binary toggle bins
Enum and case driven state objects are inferred only from unambiguous governed evidence with stable state identities
Optional next-state objects and declared legal-state sets augment current-state inference without manufacturing missing states or transitions
Standard SystemVerilog FSM description pragmas select and constrain inferred machines without accepting vendor-only spellings
VHDL source hints and language-neutral manifest hints share one validated machine description without changing HDL semantics
FSM state visits and legal transitions retain separate counters identities and aggregation results across instances and engines
Ambiguous incomplete and conflicting inferred pragma source-hint and manifest FSM descriptions fail transactionally with stable diagnostics
